/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_left h

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-- If `[c, d]` is a subinterval of `[a, b]`, then the distance between `c` and `d` is less than or
equal to that of `a` and `b` -/
theorem abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc (h : [[c, d]] ⊆ [[a, b]]) : |d - c| ≤ |b - a| := by
  rw [← max_sub_min_eq_abs, ← max_sub_min_eq_abs]
  rw [uIcc_subset_uIcc_iff_le] at h
  exact sub_le_sub h.2 h.1

/-- If `c ∈ [a, b]`, then the distance between `a` and `c` is less than or equal to
that of `a` and `b` -/
theorem abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc (h : c ∈ [[a, b]]) : |c - a| ≤ |b - a| :=
  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_left h

/-- If `x ∈ [a, b]`, then the distance between `c` and `b` is less than or equal to
that of `a` and `b` -/
theorem abs_sub_right_of_mem_uIcc (h : c ∈ [[a, b]]) : |b - c| ≤ |b - a| :=
  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_right h

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

that of `a` and `b` -/

  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_left h

  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_right h

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-- If `[c, d]` is a subinterval of `[a, b]`, then the distance between `c` and `d` is less than or
equal to that of `a` and `b` -/
theorem abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc (h : [[c, d]] ⊆ [[a, b]]) : |d - c| ≤ |b - a| := by
  rw [← max_sub_min_eq_abs, ← max_sub_min_eq_abs]

  exact sub_le_sub h.2 h.1

that of `a` and `b` -/

  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_left h

that of `a` and `b` -/

  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_right h

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

section LinearOrderedCommMonoid
variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

theorem preimage_const_add_Ici : (fun x => a + x) ⁻¹' Ici b = Ici (b - a) :=
  ext fun _x => sub_le_iff_le_add'.symm

  rw [← max_sub_min_eq_abs, ← max_sub_min_eq_abs]

that of `a` and `b` -/

  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_left h

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

section LinearOrderedCommMonoid
variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩

lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for

  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

that of `a` and `b` -/

  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_left h

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

section LinearOrderedCommMonoid
variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

equal to that of `a` and `b` -/
theorem abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc (h : [[c, d]] ⊆ [[a, b]]) : |d - c| ≤ |b - a| := by
  rw [← max_sub_min_eq_abs, ← max_sub_min_eq_abs]
  rw [uIcc_subset_uIcc_iff_le] at h
  exact sub_le_sub h.2 h.1

that of `a` and `b` -/
theorem abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc (h : c ∈ [[a, b]]) : |c - a| ≤ |b - a| :=
  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_left h

that of `a` and `b` -/
theorem abs_sub_right_of_mem_uIcc (h : c ∈ [[a, b]]) : |b - c| ≤ |b - a| :=
  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_right h

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩

  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

section LinearOrderedCommMonoid
variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma inv_Ioo (a b : α) : (Ioo a b)⁻¹ = Ioo b⁻¹ a⁻¹ := by simp [← Ioi_inter_Iio, inter_comm]

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/

and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

that of `a` and `b` -/

  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_left h

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove

-/

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for

  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-- If `[c, d]` is a subinterval of `[a, b]`, then the distance between `c` and `d` is less than or
equal to that of `a` and `b` -/
theorem abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc (h : [[c, d]] ⊆ [[a, b]]) : |d - c| ≤ |b - a| := by
  rw [← max_sub_min_eq_abs, ← max_sub_min_eq_abs]
  rw [uIcc_subset_uIcc_iff_le] at h
  exact sub_le_sub h.2 h.1

/-- If `c ∈ [a, b]`, then the distance between `a` and `c` is less than or equal to
that of `a` and `b` -/
theorem abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc (h : c ∈ [[a, b]]) : |c - a| ≤ |b - a| :=
  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_left h

/-- If `x ∈ [a, b]`, then the distance between `c` and `b` is less than or equal to
that of `a` and `b` -/
theorem abs_sub_right_of_mem_uIcc (h : c ∈ [[a, b]]) : |b - c| ≤ |b - a| :=
  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_right h

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

section ContravariantLT

variable [Mul α] [PartialOrder α] [MulLeftStrictMono α] [MulRightStrictMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Ico_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Ico_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Ico c d ⊆ Ico (a * c) (b * d) := by
  have := mulLeftMono_of_mulLeftStrictMono α
  have := mulRightMono_of_mulRightStrictMono α
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Ico_add_Icc_subset]

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

  rw [← max_sub_min_eq_abs, ← max_sub_min_eq_abs]

  abs_sub_le_of_uIcc_subset_uIcc <| uIcc_subset_uIcc_left h

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for

section ContravariantLE

variable [Mul α] [Preorder α] [MulLeftMono α] [MulRightMono α]

@[to_additive Icc_add_Icc_subset]
theorem Icc_mul_Icc_subset' (a b c d : α) : Icc a b * Icc c d ⊆ Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

@[to_additive Iic_add_Iic_subset]
theorem Iic_mul_Iic_subset' (a b : α) : Iic a * Iic b ⊆ Iic (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

@[to_additive Ici_add_Ici_subset]
theorem Ici_mul_Ici_subset' (a b : α) : Ici a * Ici b ⊆ Ici (a * b) := by
  rintro x ⟨y, hya, z, hzb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' hya hzb

end ContravariantLE

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for
-/

  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid

/-!
# (Pre)images of intervals

In this file we prove a bunch of trivial lemmas like “if we add `a` to all points of `[b, c]`,
then we get `[a + b, a + c]`”. For the functions `x ↦ x ± a`, `x ↦ a ± x`, and `x ↦ -x` we prove
lemmas about preimages and images of all intervals. We also prove a few lemmas about images under
`x ↦ a * x`, `x ↦ x * a` and `x ↦ x⁻¹`.
-/


open Interval Pointwise

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Set

/-! ### Binary pointwise operations

Note that the subset operations below only cover the cases with the largest possible intervals on
the LHS: to conclude that `Ioo a b * Ioo c d ⊆ Ioo (a * c) (c * d)`, you can use monotonicity of `*`
and `Set.Ico_mul_Ioc_subset`.

TODO: repeat these lemmas for the generality of `mul_le_mul` (which assumes nonnegativity), which
the unprimed names have been reserved for

  rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hya, hyb⟩, z, ⟨hzc, hzd⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mul_le_mul' hya hzc, mul_le_mul' hyb hzd⟩

variable [LinearOrderedCommMonoid α] [MulLeftReflectLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE α] {a b c d : α}

-- TODO: Generalise to arbitrary actions using a `smul` version of `MulLeftMono`
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_Icc (a b c : α) : a • Icc b c = Icc (a * b) (a * c) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hby, hyc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mul_le_mul_left' hby _, mul_le_mul_left' hyc _⟩
  · rintro ⟨habx, hxac⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le habx
    refine ⟨b * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxac

@[to_additive]
lemma Icc_mul_Icc (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : Icc a b * Icc c d = Icc (a * c) (b * d) := by
  refine (Icc_mul_Icc_subset' _ _ _ _).antisymm fun x ⟨hacx, hxbd⟩ ↦ ?_
  obtain hxbc | hbcx := le_total x (b * c)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hacx
    refine ⟨a * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, c, left_mem_Icc.2 hcd, mul_right_comm ..⟩
    rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_right] at hxbc
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_one_le_mul_of_le hbcx
    refine ⟨b, right_mem_Icc.2 hab, c * y, ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right' hy, ?_⟩, (mul_assoc ..).symm⟩
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left] at hxbd

end LinearOrderedCommMonoid
